div.p: All divisions and game days of this competition are planned together. You can move matches afterwards.

field.name: matchday_ids
field.help: Matches are only placed on these game days, on their courts and between their start and end times.

field.name: preferred_rest_minutes
field.help: The scheduler tries to give every team at least this much time between two matches. This is a preference: when the game days are too full it can be shorter, and you decide whether to accept that when you publish.

field.name: structure_ids
field.help: Competition formats whose matches are planned. Formats that are not generated yet are generated and frozen first.

field.name: mode
field.help: What happens to planning that already exists on the selected game days. The explanation below shows exactly what is kept and what is removed.

field.name: rebuild_reason
field.placeholder: Why the unpublished planning is rebuilt

ul.li: Each match gets its own court and time; a court never hosts two matches at once.
Matches stay on the selected game days, within their courts and hours.
Later stages are planned after the stage their teams come from.
Matches you placed by hand are kept, unless you choose to rebuild.

div.p: When a rule cannot be met, the problem appears under Must fix and nothing is planned.

p.strong: Preferences the scheduler tries to meet

ul.li: The preferred rest between a team's matches.
Teams of the same club not playing at the same time.
A fair spread of early and late matches and of courts.

div.p: Unmet preferences appear under Could improve. You can still generate and publish.

details.p: Later stages are always planned after the stage their teams come from. Pick game days only to fix a stage to part of the calendar, for example the second half or the finals day.

p.strong: Some teams cannot get the preferred rest between their matches.

div.p: Change the rest above, the game days or the courts and generate again, or use Generate anyway and accept the short rest when you publish.

page.name: must_fix
page.p: Must fix: rules that cannot be met with the current game days, courts or formats. Fix these, then generate again.

page.name: could_improve
page.p: Could improve: preferences that are not fully met. The schedule can still be generated and published.
